audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags "level chart contradicts data: Galio wins 53.33% but the chart gives Zyra 5/7 stages" as a possible error.
audit.why: Not an actual contradiction: content win[] and packet.levelChart already agree (Zyra L1-L5-minus-6 and first item, Galio L6 and 2+ items), and this exactly matches the pattern of every other matchup on this page — Galio is weak early, strong at 6 and late. Winning 2 of 7 lane stages but 53% of games overall is consistent with a scaling tank support, not a data error.
audit.corrected: No chart-direction change; only fixed the "Skill" placeholder to the already-agreed-upon side per row.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[].side values are the literal placeholder "Skill" instead of a real name.
audit.why: content win[] already agrees on the correct verdict per stage; only side/rating/why needed to move to match it.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side and phases[5].side -> Zyra; phases[4].side and phases[6].side -> Galio, why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly claims Galio's knockup "interrupts"/"cancels" Zyra's "channeled Stranglethorns" (spikes[1], mid, late, whys[4]) — but Stranglethorns carries no channel flag in the kit, unlike Vel'Koz/Xerath/Yuumi's ults which are explicitly flagged channel="interruptible — any CC cancels it". Zyra's R is an instant cast with a delayed expand-then-contract knockup, not a maintained channel.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/zyra.json R flags only list "knockup"; no channel flag. Riot's description ("summons a twisted thicket... knocking them airborne as it contracts") describes a fire-and-forget zone, not an ongoing cast Galio's CC can interrupt mid-effect. Only her brief cast window (like any ability) is interruptible by CC landed first — that's a much narrower claim than "cancels the channel."
audit.corrected: Reworded the four instances to say CC landed before/during her cast interrupts the cast, not that the R is a channel that gets canceled mid-effect.

notes: Corrected a genuine mechanical overstatement: Stranglethorns (Zyra R) is not flagged as a channel in the kit (unlike Vel'Koz/Xerath/Yuumi's ults, which are explicitly channel=interruptible), so 'cancels her channeled ult' overstated what Galio's knockup can do — it can only interrupt her brief cast window before the thicket goes off, not stop an already-summoned effect. Reworded four instances (spikes[1], mid, late, whys[4]) to the narrower, kit-supported claim. Level chart's phases[].side held the literal placeholder "Skill" on all 7 rows although win[] already had the correct verdicts; the packet's own "chart contradicts win rate" defect flag was reviewed and judged a false positive (2-of-7 lane stages plus a strong 6/late spike is consistent with a 53% overall win rate for this champion's kit pattern), so the chart direction itself was left as-is.
